comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Tech Rank: 1
Consumed Gauge: 30
Range: 100
Shatter Range: 45

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it requires just one second before the activation.

Effect:
Aside the damage, the target(s) get binded and are unable to move. They still CAN attack you, if you are within their range. This last for at least 10 seconds and higher Trap prolongs the effect. Unlike paralyze, attacking a binded target WON'T reduce the effect duration!
